name: Subconscious Impulse
body:
Level arcanist 4, bard 3, medium 2, mesmerist 3, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, spiritualist 3, witch 4; Focus hand 3, opportunist 3, supremacy 3

DESCRIPTION

As subconscious motion, except you may interrupt the target’s current actions. The actions taken in their place must be completed in up to two move actions, as well as one free action for every 3 levels. Free actions may be used to make the target communicate, including through body language. You may also decide what it will say. Finally, you may alter its speech style, tone, cadence and gait to anything within the biological limits of its body, at the cost of a free action for each change, for the duration. The quality of the changes is up to you, limited by the target’s Charisma score and skills. R target who was made to take actions that violate its nature or alignment will realize how out of character it acted when the duration expires and may suspect foul play as normal. Afterward, the target will be vigilant to its mind being influenced in this way, and subconscious impulse cannot be used to make it violate its nature or alignment again for a number of days equal to its Wisdom score.
